attempts.summary: Configured resilient static routing. The direct 10.200.0.0/30 transit is preferred at metric 10; VyOS fallback uses lan-a 10.201.0.0/30 and lan-b 10.202.0.0/30 at metric 100. Final failover converged in 4.019 seconds, source addresses were preserved, direct routing was re-preferred after restoration, and all nodes passed serial restart recovery.
